English: Wild Olive Stand
A patch of hardy, ancient olive trees growing untamed, providing a meager yet vital first resource for new arrivals.
Cleared Orchard
Land cleared and roughly fenced, with wild olives pruned and new saplings planted for steady cultivation.
Young Grove
A tidy grove of young, carefully tended olive trees, tended by nomad hands for greater yields.
Stone Press Shelter
A crude stone structure housing simple presses, allowing small-scale olive oil production from the yearly harvest.
Cured Oil Hut
Small huts for curing and storing olive oil, increasing the value and longevity of the precious resource.
Expanded Orchard
A much larger and better organized olive orchard, with irrigation and seasonal labor, yielding a steady surplus.
Walled Grove
Stone walls protect the olive groves and workers, securing the investment and deterring raids or thefts.
Olive Press House
A substantial stone building with advanced presses, producing high-quality oil for trade and clan use.
Trade Oil Pavilion
A grand tented market and storehouse, where oil is bought, sold, and traded by caravans and visiting merchants.
Iberian Olive Estate
A sprawling, fortified estate encompassing groves, presses, storage, and a bustling market, the heart of olive wealth in the clans lands.
